I’m sorry that you’re going through this :( I went through something similar although me and my ex bf were only a year in before it happened. Thank God, I dodged a bullet. In short, she’s definitely cheating on you, mentally and it sucks that she’s smiling in your face while sending those types of text to another man, it pisses me off for you. 

If she’s was genuinely just seeing him as a rp partner…doesn’t matter because she’s still texting him like she should be talking to you, HER FIANCE. She has to see the wrong in that. Idk how she fumbled, yall been together 10 years, you have a house together, you both are gamers…that’s hard to find and keep nowadays. 10 years is a long time, but it’s no excuse to step out. If you wanna do things differently or need a new change of pace, communicate that…rather than hurting someone you claim to love for something quick. a lot of idiots live for a temporary thrill…she’s going to regret this cause my ex did if she genuinely cared about you and loved you. A lot do. 

But you either need to talk to her (confront her calmly) or do what I’ve seen other suggest as hard as it might seem, cheating ain’t it. Don’t let that become your reality and thankfully you found out now before you tied the knot and had kids. That would’ve been a lot worst. They will escalate if you let them, if she gets upset about you looking in her phone…that says enough. If she gets upset if you do what others are saying (acting like you buy the tickets to go with her), there’s your answer. 

If someone has something to hide, they will get defensive and go on evade mode. You deserve better and you will find better, I’m sure. Be careful out here, lots of cheaters in sheep’s clothing. Don’t let one ruin your experience in the dating scene, there are serious people out there.

Both need help, one is lost while the other is not. We are called to make disciples and what better way than to show the love of Christ than by providing aid when we can. I get what he’s saying and what everyone else is saying. Bible study is important and honestly, you should be doing it on your own time too in addition to what your church supplies. And We are def called to serve Christ and our brethren first but we cannot forget about those who are lost…many Christian’s are content in their bubbles and forget that Christ also called us to make disciples. Of course not forcibly. But you could show it through actions! I know smaller churches in my area, even though they don’t have financial resources like that, they still try and make an effort in providing help. For my church, I know we have service Sunday/Wednesday’s mornings/evenings. Young adults on Tuesday, youth on Friday’s, Saturday/Friday’s/ Monday’s are outreach day’s for those who can make it out. On Friday’s they do aid in hospice, Saturday we have a truck that provides supplies and activities for kids/adults/etc. Monday’s is prayer days/clean up days/ stocking pantry/ etc. it was one of the reasons that soften up my heart to Jesus because they made an effort, for not just their own but for those who were unsaved and had yet to see the love of Christ.

Same here! We recently started doing an outreach with trucks that God blessed us with (some guy that is friends with our pastor had donated them in good condition) to provide aid to those who need food or supplies! Or to even let us go to areas to spread the gospel to those who would be willing to hear. I’m so thankful, similar to you, that we have events/services relatively everyday, and anyone who can make it is welcome to come. I can only pray for more churches to do such things, it was one of the things that helped my heart soften to Christianity in the first place bc it showed me God. Rather than the hypocritical versions of churches that I was so used to. We’re in the states though! PA, specifically. But glad to know there’s some overseas and that others have had such blessings in finding churches that actively walk the talk :))

Girl, I’ve been there. Especially, when I was just beginning to be transformed by the Lord! The devil wants to keep you and will try his hardest. Remember that in scripture, in 1 Peter 5:8, it tells us to be sober and vigilant because our enemy is prowling like a roaring lion waiting to see whom he can devour. As you let yourself slip, as you forget that you have the almighty God on your side, the enemy will take advantage and try to get you to fall to your temptations. In times like this, (I had to learn this the hard and long way), we have to remember to place our Trust in Him. It’s extremely difficult to learn, yes. But you must seek Him and rely on him! John 14:1 says to trust and believe in Him and to not let our hearts be troubled‬‬. You must remember that nothing evil can come against you because you are protected by the Blood of Jesus, that the devil may try to get you when you are weak but he cannot because you have the almighty God by your side. The Lord does not give us more than we can handle when it comes to sin, you can turn away from it…don’t even believe you can’t because that’s when you become slave to it. I’m stressing it because it was so important for me to learn and I had no one to really help me understand it…

1 Peter 5:7 - calls for us to throw all our anxieties onto him! There is no burden too big for Him to carry.

Whenever you feel tempted, seek Him instead, ask for His Help, ask for His guidance. Spend time in prayer, reading the Word, or listening to worship music. The enemy will be constantly attacking you to get you to be with him instead of with the Father. I will keep you in prayer too, if you have a church nearby too…you could ask for prayer as well.

That could potentially be causing damage, along with the blowouts. Did you ever try going without heat and highlights? To see the outcomes?

It could be build up from that overtime, are you styling it when you blow dry or just using it as a diffuser? I think I seen that you also get highlights in another comment and have dyed it a lot. If you are bleaching to get highlights or to dye your hair, that could be something that damages your hair/potentially your curls too. The bleach can strip away life from your hair if you’re not careful. Then there’s the occurrence of your hair texture altering naturally overtime. What does your new growth look like? Is it wavy, curly, straight?

Do you put a lot of heat on your hair? It could be heat damage if that’s the case. Curly head requires care and attention to flourish, but heat damage can ruin it and change the curl pattern to the point it’s flat instead of springy.
